title: AgentOccam: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline for LLM-Based Web Agents

layout.note: Two regions side by side behind a thick dashed vertical line: a mid-grey rounded Agent region (about two thirds of the width) with the robot and bubbles at the left, the aligned action chips at the top, the aligned observation at the bottom and a teal band in the middle; and the Environment at the right with the original action chips, the web server screenshots and the original observation text. Black loop arrows run round the outside and teal arrows cross the divider.

lesson: Put the method as a coloured band between agent and environment and show its two effects as paired Original (grey) and Aligned (teal) strips, so the reader sees what was shortened without reading prose.
